args.summary: Answer: 51 penguins were measured — Biscoe 32, Dream 13, Torgersen 6. Data problems found: (1) one exact duplicate row (row 28), removed with drop_duplicates so it wouldn't be double-counted; (2) species has label variants (' Adelie' with a leading space and 'Chinstarp' misspelling) — not relevant to the island counts, so left unchanged; (3) flipper_length_mm has 3 negative values and body_mass_g has an outlier of 3,500,000 g — not used by this question, so left unchanged. The island column itself was clean (no variants, no missing values).
